title: 3D Gaussian Splatting - Why Graphics Will Never Be The Same
summary: A two-minute explainer of 3D Gaussian Splatting, the rendering technique from a 2023 research paper. It outlines why it could change how 3D graphics are made.
why: HN uses it as a quick, non-expert primer whenever Gaussian splatting comes up.
